verdict.rationale: The evidence shows team-adjacent features: @mention team comments, shared read statuses, reply-collision indicators, and AI Auto Labels that sort incoming mail into the user's own inbox tabs. Nothing documents assigning a conversation to a teammate or routing incoming mail to an owner by rule, so ownership is never made explicit. These are adjacent collaboration and classification features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
